title: DrivingBench: Can Vision-Language Models Drive a Toyota Corolla?
abstract: arXiv:2609.38948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier models excel at many digital benchmarks, yet their ability to drive a real car, an everyday human skill, remains largely untested. We present DrivingBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark where general-purpose vision-language models must drive a real car. Through three tools, the models see camera frames from a Toyota Corolla and directly command its steering and velocity around a parking lot cone course at low speeds. The car may continue moving while the model thinks and new commands replace the currently running one, so inference latency is part of the task, testing the models' abilities to observe, act, monitor, recover, and complete a long-horizon objective under such constraints. We benchmark GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Grok 4.6 in vendor-native harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) with up to three attempts each in one conversation; Astra is the only model to finish the course, on its second at

translated_title: DrivingBench：视觉语言模型能驾驶丰田卡罗拉吗？
translated_abstract: 前沿模型在众多数字基准测试中表现出色，但它们能否驾驶真实汽车——一项日常人类技能——在很大程度上仍未经过检验。我们提出了 DrivingBench，据我们所知，这是首个要求通用视觉语言模型驾驶真实汽车的基准测试。通过三个工具，模型可以查看来自丰田卡罗拉的摄像头画面，并直接指令其转向与速度，在低速下绕行停车场锥桶赛道。模型思考期间汽车可能仍在移动，且新指令会替换当前正在执行的指令，因此推理延迟成为任务的一部分，以此测试模型在这些约束下观察、行动、监控、恢复并完成长期目标的能力。我们在厂商原生框架中测试了 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Grok 4.6，每个模型在一次对话中最多有三次尝试机会；Astra 是唯一完成赛道的模型，在第二次尝试时……
tldr: DrivingBench 是首个要求通用视觉语言模型驾驶真实丰田卡罗拉、并将推理延迟纳入任务约束以考察模型观察、行动、监控与恢复能力的真实驾驶基准测试，其中 GPT-6 Astra 是唯一完成赛道的模型。
en_tdlr: DrivingBench is the first benchmark requiring general-purpose vision-language models to drive a real Toyota Corolla, where inference latency is part of the task, and GPT-6 Astra is the only model to complete the course.
